articles.title: El Real Madrid vuelve a creer
articles.standfirst: La victoria en El Clásico contra el Barcelona recortó la distancia a tres puntos... y recobró la moral del equipo de Mourinho
articles.summary: La victoria en El Clásico contra el Barcelona recortó la distancia a tres puntos... y recobró la moral del equipo de Mourinho
articles.body: José Mourinho llegó al Real Madrid en el verano de 2010, después de conquistar la Champions League con el Inter de Milán, con una misión tan ambiciosa como complicada: frenar el dominio del Barcelona de Pep Guardiola. Lo consiguió levantando la Copa del Rey en su primera temporada y conquistando LaLiga en la segunda... además de alcanzar tres semifinales consecutivas de Champions. Un camino que sirvió de antesala a la Décima, certificada por Carlo Ancelotti en 2014. Más de 15 años después, Florentino Pérez volvió a apostar por la misma fórmula... y el Real Madrid ha vuelto a creer. El conjunto blanco afrontaba El Clásico con la sensación de disputar una final cuando apenas se había alcanzado la jornada 10 del campeonato. No era un partido más de tres puntos: una derrota podía dejarle a nueve del Barcelona, mientras que una victoria reducía la distancia a tres. La presión era máxima y los fantasmas del pasado amenazaban con aparecer. La goleada por 5-0 que Mourinho sufrió en el Camp Nou en 2010 alimentaba los temores de que la historia pudiera repetirse... aunque, esta vez, el desenlace fue muy diferente. La derrota del Barcelona frente al PSG en Champions, que puso fin a su pleno de victorias, había abierto una ventana de esperanza para los madridistas. El equipo de Mourinho supo aprovecharla y firmó su mejor actuación en las tres últimas temporadas para asaltar el feudo azulgrana con un doblete de Kylian Mbappé como gran argumento ofensivo. Un triunfo que va mucho más allá de la clasificación: devuelve la confianza a un vestuario que necesitaba una noche así después de dos temporadas sin títulos y demuestra que puede competir de tú a tú con un rival que había arrancado el curso a un ritmo extraordinario. Las apuestas deportivas también empiezan a reflejar el nuevo escenario... aunque William Hill mantiene la cautela pese al golpe de autoridad madridista. El Barcelona continúa como favorito para conquistar LaLiga, con una cuota de 1.29, mientras que el título del Real Madrid se paga a 4.5. Las mejores casas de apuestas siguen dando ventaja al conjunto azulgrana en la carrera por el campeonato, pero El Clásico ha demostrado que la distancia entre ambos puede reducirse cuando el equipo blanco encuentra su mejor versión. Ahora, el Real Madrid sabe que vuelve a estar en la pelea y que tiene argumentos para discutirle el título al Barcelona. Los dos equipos afrontan una semana limpia para preparar sus próximos compromisos, ante el Racing y el Alavés, respectivamente. Sin embargo, el escenario es muy diferente para cada uno: los blancos llegan reforzados por una victoria que puede marcar un punto de inflexión, mientras que los azulgranas deberán reaccionar después de encadenar dos derrotas en su primera semana verdaderamente exigente del curso. La Liga todavía es larga, pero El Clásico ha devuelto la ilusión al madridismo.

articles.title: De coche familiar a casa sobre ruedas: así son las camper de Stellantis que triunfan en España
articles.standfirst: Desde modelos compactos con cama hasta auténticas casas con cocina, salón y baño: el negocio camper crece un 14,6% en España y Stellantis domina más de la mitad del mercado
articles.summary: Las próximas vacaciones pueden empezar al girar la llave y terminar donde tú quieras con las campers de Stellantis que permiten llevar la cama, la cocina y hasta el salón a bordo para cambiar los hoteles por paisajes, improvisar escapadas y viajar con total libertad. No es casualidad que el grupo ya controle el 53% del mercado camper español.
articles.body: Un coche para ir a trabajar entre semana y una pequeña casa para escaparse el viernes. Con cama para dormir, cocina para preparar la cena y hasta un salón improvisado, las campers permiten disfrutar de las vacaciones sin depender de hoteles. Y no todas requieren desembolsar los 60.000 o 70.000 euros que muchos imaginan: hay propuestas anunciadas desde 32.000 euros. En España, Stellantis Pro One se ha convertido en protagonista de esta tendencia gracias a su amplia experiencia, forjada durante dos décadas ofreciendo desde furgonetas transformadas hasta modelos utilizables tanto en el día a día como en las vacaciones. Tiene propuestas en sus marcas Fiat Professional, Citroën, Peugeot y Opel y las cifras le avalan: durante los nueve primeros meses de 2026, Stellantis vendió 6.369 unidades, lo que supone una cuota del 53% en un mercado que creció un 14,6%. El Citroën Holidays es una de las propuestas más completas para quienes buscan escapadas cómodas sin renunciar a un vehículo práctico durante la semana. Basado en el SpaceTourer, ofrece espacio para cuatro personas, techo elevable, dos camas, cocina, fregadero, frigorífico de 16 litros y mesa desmontable. Los asientos delanteros giratorios permiten crear una zona de reunión, mientras que la calefacción Webasto ayuda a mantener el confort cuando bajan las temperaturas. La cama superior mide 1,20 metros de ancho por 1,95 de largo. Abajo, el asiento corrido se transforma en otra cama para dos ocupantes. Las puertas laterales correderas facilitan cocinar o comer al aire libre, y puede añadirse un toldo para ganar sombra. Disponible desde 57.800 euros, combina equipamiento camper y dimensiones pensadas también para el uso urbano. Otra alternativa es el FIAT Ducato, una base de referencia en el caravaning europeo con más de 40 años de trayectoria. Su interior regular facilita distribuir las zonas de descanso, cocina y almacenamiento. También existen chasis específicos para autocaravanas, con soluciones destinadas a mejorar el aprovechamiento del espacio y la estabilidad. La seguridad es otro argumento: incorpora asistentes como frenada automática de emergencia, control inteligente de velocidad y mantenimiento de carril. Los asientos giratorios Captain Chair ayudan a integrar la cabina en el salón cuando el vehículo está estacionado. El Peugeot Rifter by Tinkervan ( desde 32.000 €) apuesta por dimensiones compactas y modularidad. Su sistema Flexibed Sport permite elegir entre maletero despejado, cama individual con espacio para material deportivo o cama completa. El techo elevable añade otra zona de descanso, y los asientos giratorios y la mesa plegable crean un pequeño salón. Para quienes priorizan un vehículo polivalente, el Opel Zafira by Tinkervan (desde 39.000 €) combina cinco plazas para el día a día con soluciones para dormir y pasar tiempo en el interior. Su techo elevable panorámico incorpora una cama de dos metros de largo, mientras que la configuración interior permite transformar el espacio y disponer de camas adicionales. Según el equipamiento, suma batería auxiliar, iluminación LED, ducha eléctrica, calefacción estacionaria y módulo de cocina. Sobre la base de la Fiat Ducato trabaja Nomade Nation, fabricante con sede en Barcelona. Sus gamas Neo y Space (desde 73.500 €) proponen interiores de inspiración nórdica, aislamiento Kaiflex de 20 milímetros y diferentes configuraciones para grupos pequeños o viajes de hasta cuatro plazas, según la versión. Pueden incluir calefacción, cocina, baño, depósitos de agua y control domótico. La experiencia camper no depende solo del equipamiento interior. Stellantis Pro One trabaja con carroceros especializados y ofrece asistencia en carretera las 24 horas en Europa, además de una red de talleres para atender estos vehículos. Fiat Professional cuenta con más de 6.500 talleres europeos, incluidos 1.800 especializados en autocaravanas. Con propuestas que van de la furgoneta compacta a la autocaravana, estas opciones permiten elegir el vehículo según el destino, los ocupantes y el tipo de aventura. La clave es adaptar la distribución y el equipamiento a la forma de viajar, para disfrutar de cada parada con independencia y comodidad.

articles.title: "Won't Be in Texas": Steve Sarkisian Receives Arch Manning Exit Warning as SEC Rival Emerges as Potential Landing Spot
articles.summary: Arch Manning’s future at Texas has become a talking point as the Longhorns work through a challenging stretch of the season. With questions surrounding his p...
articles.body:
Arch Manning's future at Texas has become a talking point as the Longhorns work through a challenging stretch of the season. With questions surrounding his performances and Steve Sarkisian's plans at quarterback, attention is turning to what could lie ahead for the young quarterback.

In a post shared by Bleacher Report CFB on X on October 26, college football analyst David Pollack suggested that Arch Manning could leave Texas after the 2026 season, with Georgia emerging as a potential landing spot. Pollack cited a conversation with an SEC head coach who would be surprised if Manning did not end up with the Bulldogs, a team he had previously committed to.

"Arch ain't gonna be there next year… he won't be in Texas," David Pollack said .

Manning's numbers through the first six games of the 2026 season reflected a mixed campaign. Before Texas faced Ole Miss on October 24, the quarterback had recorded 1,295 passing yards, 11 passing touchdowns and five interceptions. Consecutive 27–24 defeats to Oklahoma and Florida increased pressure on the offense, particularly after turnovers contributed to the Longhorns' struggles in close games.

Against Oklahoma on October 10, Manning threw for 260 yards and three touchdowns but also recorded two interceptions. The following week, he completed 14 of 20 passes for 173 yards and one touchdown against Florida. Texas lost both games by three points, leaving the team looking for a response as its season continued.

The results also placed greater attention on Manning's decision-making. Despite entering college as a highly rated quarterback prospect, he has faced the challenge of delivering consistent performances as Texas' starter.

Sarkisian confirmed on October 19 that Manning would remain the starting quarterback, even after Texas suffered two straight losses. He admitted that Manning needed to improve, but also said the entire offense had to step up. Backup KJ Lacey Jr. got more reps with the first team in practice, yet Sarkisian continued to back Manning before the Ole Miss game.

Texas went on to beat Ole Miss 34–27 on October 24, ending its two-game losing streak and moving to 5–2. Manning completed 18 of 30 passes for 212 yards and a touchdown, but threw two interceptions. He also scored twice on the ground to help Texas secure the win.

Manning was not the only Texas player to make a difference in the win. Running back Raleek Brown recorded 157 rushing yards on 23 carries, while wide receiver Ryan Wingo finished with seven catches for 111 yards and a touchdown.

The victory was a much-needed boost for the Longhorns, though Manning's interceptions remained a concern. His performances in the remaining games could play a role in decisions about his future, but there is no confirmation that he plans to leave Texas after the 2026 season.

Georgia had been one of Manning's options during his recruitment. The Bulldogs pursued him before he committed to Texas on June 23, 2022. Despite Georgia's interest, Manning chose to join the Longhorns.

For now, Georgia is only a possible destination raised in Pollack's prediction. Last week, NFL analyst Tom Pelissero had linked Manning to Ole Miss, a program with ties to the family.

articles.title: WWE Raw Live Updates, Results and Highlights From October 26
articles.summary: Welcome to Bleacher Report's live coverage of WWE Raw on October 26.
articles.body:
Welcome to Bleacher Report's live coverage of WWE Raw on October 26.

Scroll down for updates from throughout the show.

As Tiffy was preparing to cash in her contract for a title shot, Dominik Mysterio showed up and dragged Morgan out of the ring to save her title reign and end the show.

We returned from the final break to see Lynch hit a superplex followed by a DDT for a close two-count.

Morgan brought her out of the ring and cleared off the announce table. Becky countered and hit the Manhandle Slam on top of the table. Morgan was able to hit a sunset flip on the floor to even the odds a bit.

The ref continued to count both women out, but they made it back in before 10. They traded punches and trash talk until Morgan hit Oblivion out of nowhere for a very close two-count.

Becky popped up and hit a Manhandle Slam, but Liv kicked out. Lynch got her into the DisArmHer, but Raquel and Roxy showed up and distracted Becky, allowing Liv to get to the bottom rope.

Becky took out the rest of Judgment Day and then hit the Manhandle Slam one more time, but as she was about to win the title, Raquel and Roxy attacked her to cause a DQ.

Chelsea Green came out to help Becky since she is set to face Morgan at Crown Jewel. The numbers were too much for her, but Iyo Sky came out to even the score.

Iyo hit a moonsault, but her back caught the corner of the table on the way down. Meanwhile, Green hit her finisher on Morgan, but then Roxy sent her out of the ring.

That is when Tiffany Stratton came out with the MITB briefcase.

We returned from a break to see Morgan using a Boston crab while Becky was in the ropes, so she was forced to break at five. She hit the Three Amigos, but Lynch reversed the third suplex.

The Man made a comeback and hit a leg drop from the middle rope for a two-count. She brought Liv down from the middle rope with a Russian leg sweep, but it wasn't enough to get the win.

Liv Morgan vs. Becky Lynch (Women's World Championship) Part 1

The main event this week saw Becky Lynch challenge Liv Morgan for the women's world title. Morgan looked like she was in a bad mood on her way to the ring. She didn't sing along with her entrance music or dance around like she usually does.

They locked up and Morgan used the ropes to force a break. They traded a few two-counts as they went back and forth. The Man took control as the fight left the ring and the show cut to a break.

We returned to see Page getting a two-count on Lee. Gable tagged in and hit Cass with a nice German suplex.

He tagged Lee back in, and he started to go on a roll against both opponents. He sent Cass out of the ring and then sent Page out the other side. He then hit both men with back-to-back suicide dives.

Gable ended up taking a bump at ringisde that had the ref leave the ring to check on him. Cass and Lee continued to fight in the ring. A few officials sprinted from the back to help Gable as Lee faced both opponents on his own.

Cass hit a big boot, and Page followed with an Egoplex for the win.

The way this ended felt improvised, so Gable might actually be hurt. We hope for his sake, it's nothing serious.

Dragon Lee and Chad Gable vs. Big Cass and Ethan Page Part 1

The next match saw Dragon Lee team up with Chad Gable to take on Big Cass and Ethan Page.

Gable and Page started for their teams, but it wasn't long before Lee tagged in. Page scooped him up for a slam before tagging Cass in to dominate the luchador.

Gable tagged back in and sent Lee flying over the top rope to take out both opponents at once.

We returned to see Rodriguez break out of a sleeper. She caught Iyo coming off the top rope and went for a chokeslam, but Iyo turned it into a DDT for a two-count.

The Genius of the Sky got Raquel into position for a moonsault, but Raquel rolled out of the way and then hit a running crossbody for a near-fall. Sky hit a hurricanrana from the middle rope, but then she ran right into a big boot.

Sky made a comeback and hit a running meteora. She hopped to the top rope, but Rodriguez countered the moonsault. She tried to hit a powerbomb, but Sky rolled her up for the pin.

As Sky was celebrating, Roxanne Perez attacked her from behind. She and Raquel took Iyo out to end the segment.

After a quick video promo, Iyo Sky made her way to the ring to take on Raquel Rodriguez. This was a non-title match, so Raquel's Intercontinental Championship was safe for the time being.

They locked up and Raquel immediately took Iyo down by the waist and then swung her around and threw her halfway across the ring. Sky pounced on her and locked in a guillotine, but Rodriguez powered out of it.

Sky used her speed to keep control and hit a suicide dive. She got on the barricade and hit a crossbody before celebrating with some young fans at ringside.

We returned to see Lyra using a kendo stick to choke Bayley. They fought over the kendo stick until Bayley got her hands on it and swung it a few times. She then took off her belts to repay Valkyria for what she did earlier.

Lyra tried to hit a spin kick, but Bayley captured her for a suplex. She sent Valkyria into a chair in the corner, but it only got a two-count. She went back under the ring for a second table and set it up next to the announce table.

When Bayley went for an elbow drop, Lyra pulled a chair onto her chest so Bayley crashed into it. She positioned Bayley on two chairs and climbed to the middle rope. She went for a moonsault, but Bayley moved and she hit the chairs.

Lyra kicked out of the Bayley to Belly, so Bayley set the chairs up again. Lyra ended up countering and hitting the Nightwing before locking Bayley in a crossface. They rolled out of the ring to break the hold.

Bayley grabbed a garbage can as Valkyria pleaded with her not to use it. She threw her jacket into Bayley's face and then hit a kick to take her down. She jumped off the apron, but Bayley hit a powerbomb onto the garbage can.

She placed Valkyria on the table and hit a diving elbow drop. She threw Lyra back in and put her in a crossface with a kendo stick to get the submission win.

This was a hell of a match. Both women made this incredibly fun.

Bayley and Lyra Valkyria were looking to put this feud to bed with a No DQ match after the break. Evans and Penta were shown asking Pearce for a shot at the tag titles against The Vision. Pearce booked it for Crown Jewel.

Lyra made her way to the ring second. Kelani Jordan from NXT was shown watching from the crowd as the match began. Bayley tackled Lyra as soon as the bell rang and started beating her down.

She went under the ring and started putting chairs, a kendo stick and a broom into the ring. The crowd popped when she set up a table next to the ring, but Valkyria dove over it to take her down.

Valkyria used a belt to inflict some damage before whipping Bayley into the steel steps. Bayley recovered and set up Lyra on a chair so she could jump off the steps and clothesline her. She tried to do the same thing from the barricade, but Lyra tripped her.

Valkyria dropkicked Bayley into the steps and rolled her in for a two-count. She set up the table against the announce table, and then Bayley hit a suicide dive to put both of them through it.

WWE aired a video package recapping what happened last week between The Bloodline and 946.

We returned from the break to see Zayn in control. Evans tried to get himself back into the fight, and some slaps from Sami helped him get the motivation to fight back. He nailed the red dot kick, but only got a two-count.

Zayn managed to pull him to the corner and hit the exploder suplex. He lined up for the Helluva Kick, but Evans fired off a superkick first. The Young OG climbed to the top rope and hit a big frog splash, but Zayn kicked out.

As Sami attempted to leave the match and lose by countout, Penta came out with the MITB briefcase. Sami got back in the ring and almost got pinned by Evans. Penta tried to cheer Evans on, but Bron Breakker attacked him from behind.

Evans took out Breakker with a dive over the top rope, but that allowed Zayn to recover. He hit the exploder suplex followed by the Helluva Kick to get the pin and the win.

Breakker got into the ring and allowed Zayn to leave so he could attack Evans. Penta came back to help, but Bronson Reed showed up to wipe him out. Evans took a Spear from Breakker and a Tsunami from Reed while Logan Paul laughed at ringside. Penta got the same treatment.

Sami Zayn vs. Je'Von Evans (WWE Championship) Part 1

The show cut to a break and when it returned, the match was already in progress. They locked up and fought for control in the corner. Zayn hit a few shoulder thrusts to Evans' injured ribs.

Evans hit a nice hurricanrana for a quick two-count. He hit Sami with a few chest chops before the champion took him down with a clothesline.

Je'Von started to build some momentum and sent Zayn out of the ring so he could hit a huge dive over the top rope. He tried to hit a move from the top rope, but Zayn shoved him off and he hit the apron on the way down.

Zayn said maybe Evans will be on his level in 5-8 years, but until then, he doesn't even get to look the champion in the eye. Pearce came back out and said Zayn can earn some respect tonight when he faces Evans for the WWE title after the break.

Zayn complained about not being booked for the show despite being asked to fly there by Pearce. He said the only reason he was needed was that Roman Reigns isn't there again. He told Pearce to get out of the ring so he could get something off his chest.

Zayn insulted the crowd by saying they only respond to things that are spoon-fed to them. Zayn ranted for a few minutes about how underrated and underappreciated he is.

Je'Von Evans came out to interrupt after Zayn mentioned him doing the same thing previously. He told Sami to say whatever he has to say to his face. Zayn said he doesn't owe Evans any respect, but he will show him respect anyway because he is a good guy.

He told Evans he should never interrupt him again. The Young OG made a vague threat and said maybe Reigns was right about Sami not being the champion by Crown Jewel.

Raw is officially on the air! The show opened with shots of Fresno, California. We also got the usual shots of people walking backstage before we went into the arena to see Adam Pearce in the ring.

He revealed that Stephanie Vaquer is not medically cleared to compete tonight, but Becky Lynch is ready to fight, so he is booking her against Liv Morgan for the world title tonight.

Before he could continue, he was interrupted by Sami Zayn.

articles.title: Andre Agassi bought a Las Vegas land parcel for $6.5 million in 2018 and sold it for $18.15 million in 2026
articles.summary: Earlier this year, tennis legend Andre Agassi turned a piece of prime Las Vegas real estate into an $18.15 million payday.
articles.body: Earlier this year, tennis legend Andre Agassi turned a piece of prime Las Vegas real estate into an $18.15 million payday. The 55-year-old former champion sold a vacant 1.8-acre homesite in the exclusive Summit Club community, earning nearly three times what he paid for the property in 2018. The deal offers a glimpse into the value of luxury land in Summerlin, where privacy, sweeping views and high-end amenities attract wealthy buyers. Yet the sale also reflects a personal change for Agassi, who reportedly reconsidered his plans for a sprawling family home as he moves towards a new stage of life.Andre Agassi earns $11.65 million from his Las Vegas property saleAgassi purchased the land for $6.5 million in 2018, according to property records cited by the Las Vegas Review-Journal. Its sale for $18.15 million represents a gain of $11.65 million before taxes, fees and other costs. The price highlights the appeal of the Summit Club, a guard-gated luxury community in Summerlin known for its large estates and exclusive facilities.The 1.8-acre parcel sits on the western edge of the Las Vegas Valley. Its elevated position offers broad views of the city and surrounding mountains, making it an attractive site for a custom-built mansion. The community also features an 18-hole golf course, a luxury clubhouse and an outdoor team that helps residents explore the region.Despite the property's potential, Agassi never filed development plans for the site, according to Clark County records. His brother and listing agent, Phillip Agassi, said the tennis star had initially considered building a large home there. However, with his children growing older, downsizing became a more practical choice.The sale also stands out because the buyer's identity remains undisclosed. The purchase closed in February 2026 through a series of limited-liability companies, making it difficult to establish who ultimately acquired the land.Andre Agassi's Summit Club sale highlights luxury real estate demandAgassi's property deal adds to the appeal of Summerlin, a master-planned community that has attracted affluent residents, including actor Mark Wahlberg. The Summit Club's privacy and extensive security measures help distinguish it from other luxury developments in the Las Vegas area.Tyler Brady, owner of Brady Luxury Homes, highlighted the community's security, saying, “You’re not getting into the Summit and not getting caught,” he said.Agassi built his fortune through a remarkable tennis career, winning eight major singles titles and an Olympic gold medal. He also earned more than $31 million in career prize money, while his wife, Steffi Graf, remains one of the sport's most celebrated champions.The $18.15 million sale shows how valuable a well-positioned piece of land can become in a sought-after luxury market. articles.title: WWE Raw Winners, Live Grades, Reaction and Highlights From October 26
articles.summary: WWE rolled into Fresno, California, on Monday night for the latest episode of Raw, headlined by a dream match of sorts as Becky Lynch battled Stephanie Vaquer for a shot at Liv Morgan's Women's World Championship.
articles.body:
WWE rolled into Fresno, California, on Monday night for the latest episode of Raw, headlined by a dream match of sorts as Becky Lynch battled Stephanie Vaquer for a shot at Liv Morgan's Women's World Championship.

Who emerged victoriously from the high-stakes match-up and the rest of the night's loaded card?

Find out with this recap of the October 26 broadcast, featuring grades and analysis for each of the show's biggest matches and moments.

Announced in advance of Monday's show were:

Women's World Championship No. 1 Contender's Match: Becky Lynch vs. Stephanie Vaquer

No Disqualification Match: Bayley vs. Lyra Valkyria

Chad Gable and Dragon Lee vs. Big Cass and Ethan Page

The Raw general manager kicked off the show, revealing to the fans in Fresno that Stephanie Vaquer is unable to compete.

Her scheduled opponent, Becky Lynch, is in the arena. As a result, The Man will challenge the Women's World Champion Liv Morgan, for the title tonight.

Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn interrupted the proceedings and took exception to Pearce not booking him on the show, despite bringing him to Fresno for promotional photos.

After dismissing the authority figure, he turned his irritation toward the fans, telling them that they need to be spoon-fed everything, citing Trick Williams and CM Punk as proof.

He claimed that his joining The Bloodline took the wrestling world to new heights and took credit for WWE having a lucrative Netflix contract. He claimed no one puts all of the pieces together like him, unless their names are Shawn Michaels, Eddie Guerrero, and Kurt Angle, but he will not brag about that.

He took exception to Superstars coming out and interrupting him, specifically mentioning Penta and Je'Von Evans, the latter of whom interrupted him. Evans told The Last Real Good Guy to say it to his face.

A lengthy exchange ended with Pearce booking Evans vs. Zayn for the WWE title next.

A 20-minute heel promo at the top of the show? Is this 2003?

"While you're trying to be one of the best, I'm trying to be the best," Evans said. A killer line from a young face of the future.

Zayn killed it in this promo. There was sense of truth to everything he said and being allowed to cut these scathing promos has to be cathartic for a wrestler who, to his point, is probably underrated and undervalued considering his resume and contributions over the last decade.

Zayn vs. Evans to kick off the show? Yes, please.

Undisputed WWE Championship Match: Je'Von Evans vs. Sami Zayn

Last Time in Action: Je'Von Evans lost the ladder match (Money in the Bank, October 10); Sami Zayn, Johnny Gargano, and Ricky Saints lost to Rey Fenix, Penta, and Trick Williams (SmackDown, October 23)

Zayn narrowly escaped Fresno with his Undisputed WWE Championship intact following a grueling match with Evans.

The Young OG pushed the Last Real Good Guy to the brink more than once, delivering a frog splash late in the match that the champion just narrowly kicked out of.

Midway through the bout, Penta appeared and teased a Money in the Bank cash-in, only for Bron Breakker to attack out of nowhere. The distraction ultimately led to Zayn delivering the Helluva Kick for the pin and the win.

After the match, The Vision beat down and left The Vision lying in a heap to close out the segment, with Penta and Evans each suffering a spear from Breakker and a Tsunami from Bronson Reed.

Evans and Zayn's chemistry is off the charts. This was a fun, totally unexpected match.

WWE would not possibly be silly enough to book an angle where Breakker beats Penta for the briefcase, would it? Because the way the Badass looked at the guaranteed title shot feels like for foreshadowing.

The Vision still feels like a second-tier faction, no matter how often they get over on the opposition. It lacks that one big figure right in the middle, someone who can bring championship credibility and considerable WWE success to the table.

Last Time In Action: Lyra Valkyria defeated Bayley (Raw, September 21); Valkyria lost to Lola Vice (Raw, October 19)

After months of physical and mental torment, Bayley finally achieved revenge over Lyra Valkyria in a No Disqualification Match on Monday.

Having lost two consecutive matches to her former friend and tag team partner, the Role Model did not miss a chance to punish Valkyria. She whipped her with a belt, used a kendo stick, and rolled out of the way during a moonsault attempt, leaving her opponent to crash and burn ribs first on a chair.

Along the way, she absorbed tremendous punishment in her own right, including a missed elbow that caught a steel chair. She never gave up, never let the pain and suffering get the best of her.

Instead, Bayley showed the same resiliency that had come to define her entire WWE career. She caught Valkyria mid-flight with a powerbomb onto a trash can, then delivered an elbow drop from the ropes, driving her opponent through a table on the floor.

Back inside, she downed Valkyria, applied a crossface with kendo stick to the mouth, and forced the submission.

Backstage, Adam Pearce caught up with Je'Von Evans and Penta and gave them a shot at Bron Breakker and Austin Theory's World Tag Team Championship at Crown Jewel.

Bayley took a wicked front bump on the guardrail that could have been far worse than it was. Ditto a table bump moments later. It is a testament to both women that they were not hurt in any major way.

This was a fantastic feud-ender. It featured some great, intense action that left its mark on the competitors involved. The crowd was right there with everything they did as the action intensified and the finish was great.

This was a great moment for Bayley. If she is, in fact, continuing her career with WWE, this is a momentum builder.

articles.title: Tommy Paul and wife Paige Lorenze list two properties for a combined $5.3 million after buying their Connecticut dream home
articles.summary: Earlier this year, tennis star Tommy Paul and his wife, Paige Lorenze, made a major move towards building their future together.
articles.body: Earlier this year, tennis star Tommy Paul and his wife, Paige Lorenze, made a major move towards building their future together. The couple listed their separate homes for a combined $5.29 million after discovering a property they believe could become their forever home. With millions of dollars tied up in real estate, the listings reveal how their priorities are changing as they prepare for marriage and consider starting a family. Their decision also puts two very different luxury properties on the market, each offering buyers a distinct lifestyle.Tommy Paul and Paige Lorenze list homes worth $5.29 millionPaul, 28, has listed his modern Boca Raton mansion in Florida for $2.8 million. The tennis player purchased the property in 2023 for $2.5 million, meaning he could make a $300,000 profit if it sells at the asking price, before taxes and expenses.His five-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home offers more than 3,000 square feet of living space on a 0.23-acre plot. Built in 2023, the property features a gourmet kitchen, a detached guesthouse and a resort-style pool and spa. Large sliding doors bring natural light into the home and connect its indoor spaces with the outdoor area.Lorenze, meanwhile, listed her Connecticut property for $2.49 million, slightly above the $2.4 million she paid in 2024. The 5,000-square-foot house sits on 2.14 acres and includes four bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a gourmet kitchen, a swimming pool and several living spaces. Its location, about 60 miles from Manhattan, makes it suitable as both a weekend retreat and a full-time residence.Both listings could deliver a profit, although the final returns will depend on the sale prices and transaction costs.Paige Lorenze reveals why Tommy Paul’s new home changed their plansThe listings appear closely tied to the couple's search for a shared home. Lorenze explained in a December YouTube video that she had not planned to move until she found a property that matched their future ambitions.“I was actually not looking to move,” she revealed in December. “[But I] stumbled upon this listing and it had everything that I could ever imagine.”She described the property as her “dream forever home” after visiting it with Paul soon after Thanksgiving. Privacy, more land and room for their interests helped convince them that the move made sense.“More privacy is really important to me, more land is important to me, and this property has so many of the things that Tommy and I love.”The new property reportedly includes a tennis court, a large barn, a guesthouse and enough space for Lorenze's horses. It would also give Paul a place to train between tournaments.The couple began dating in 2022 and announced their engagement in July 2025 after Paul proposed during a getaway in Nantucket. They plan to move into the new home in February, while Paul continues his demanding tennis schedule and Lorenze prepares to join him in Australia for the Australian Open.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Cardinals Coach Reveals Key Jeremiyah Love Update Ahead of Cowboys Game
articles.summary: The Arizona Cardinals (2-5) are heading into a massive week 8 showdown with the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday.The Cardinals have an opportunity to defeat Dallas f...
articles.body:
The Arizona Cardinals (2-5) are heading into a massive week 8 showdown with the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday.

The Cardinals have an opportunity to defeat Dallas for the fifth consecutive regular season meeting.

One of the avenues to do just this is by running a slumping offense through running back Jeremiyah Love.

The issue? Love is coming off two straight games of sitting out due to an ankle injury.

Despite this, there seems to be hope that a return is imminent. Read more below on a key update from the afternoon of Oct. 26.

Cardinals Head Coach Reveals Major Love Update

First-year Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur revealed during Monday's press conference that the 21-year-old Love will return to practice on Wednesday ( AZ Cardinals X ).

This is undeniably a major development for an Arizona offense that needs a spark. Between quarterback Jacoby Brissett being risk-averse, facing stout defenses, and struggling in the red zone, returning Love is one of the best responses to recent turmoil.

Another piece of the equation is reserve Tyler Allgeier starting off the season in disappointing fashion. The BYU product is averaging a meager 2.9 yards per carry and is losing steam to the third-string Bam Knight.

The return to practice seems encouraging for the Notre Dame alum's prospects of returning to game action this week. Read more below on why this is the perfect runway for Love to finally hit a breakthrough in the NFL .

Love's Potential Return Comes at Perfect Time

The Cowboys' defense came into the season as one that was vastly better on paper.

Between the drafting of Caleb Downs, a new DC in Christian Parker, and more continuity for the d-line, this was seemingly a quality unit in-waiting.

Well, this hasn't come to fruition in any imagination of the theory.

For starters, the Dallas defense ranks 30th in total defense and 32nd in third-down efficiency – ceding an alarming 47.3% conversion rate on the key down.

Perhaps the most disheartening stat is the underwhelming run defense. The defensive front was pining to be a strength of the group, but it has been anything other than stout. As a matter of fact, Dallas ranks 31st in run defense, giving up 149.8 yards per game on the ground.

Part of this is less-than-ideal starts from interior lineman Kenny Clark and Quinnen Williams. Clark ( 59.8 PFF grade ) and Williams ( 63.2 ) are massive disappointments thus far, especially relative to contract value.

This opens the door for a Love return to be particularly fruitful for the Cardinals. Running the rookie out against the Los Angeles Rams or Denver Broncos wasn't a wise avenue to take. Easing the top-five pick back into action against one of the worst defenses in football is the much wiser approach.

Whether Love returns to action or not is for the rest of the week to decide. However, already confirming a return to practice is a positive sign.

Monitoring Love's status as the week progresses is key for Cardinals fans to reach an ultimate conclusion.

articles.title: Eagles take advantage of Cowboys' defensive mistakes for 14-10 lead

articles.body:
The Cowboys defense isn't good, and they can't get out of their own way either.

The Cowboys had the Eagles stopped on fourth-and-1 at the Philadelphia 44 on an aborted snap. Defensive lineman Quinnen Williams was called for offsides, though, giving the Eagles a first down.

It was Williams' second offsides penalty in the first quarter and the Cowboys' third.

The Cowboys stopped the Eagles on third-and-7 at the Dallas 9, too, only to have LT Overton called for roughing the passer. The rookie hit Tanner McKee in the facemask.

Dameon Pierce ran it in from the 5 on the next play.

The Eagles lead 14-10, gaining 132 yards and scoring two touchdowns on two drives.

The Eagles have ruled out wide receiver Britain Covey (knee).

articles.title: Is Cason Wallace Out For Season? Thunder Injury News Crushes $139 Million Decision
articles.summary: The Oklahoma City Thunder could’ve never expected this when they gave Cason Wallace a five-year contract extension worth $139 million in total value earlier...
articles.body:
The Oklahoma City Thunder could've never expected this when they gave Cason Wallace a five-year contract extension worth $139 million in total value earlier this month.

But OKC is now going to have to play a lot of this season without its point guard after an injury Monday night put about the worst possible outcome onto the table for Wallace.

Most of the focus will be about Jalen Williams, whose gruesome left leg injury is going to keep him out for most or all of the season.

On Monday night, ESPN's Shams Charania reported that Williams has a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula and will be out for at least "several months."

There wasn't as much expectation about a brutal update on Wallace, though, but that's exactly what the Thunder got.

Wallace could be out for the entire season. Even if he's not, he's going to be out for a long time.

Charania wrote the update like this on his X account:

Thunder GM Sam Presti did clarify that it's probably a 5-to-6 month recovery timeline for the labrum tear on Wallace.

Six months would take him to April, which would be a chance to return for the playoffs — if he's able to ramp up to speed in time.

Wallace tore the labrum in his left shoulder on a play against the Minnesota Timberwolves in the first half Sunday night, and it was one of those where you wondered if it had gotten dislocated — the shoulder didn't look quite right afterward.

Turns out it was a labrum tear, an injury more commonly associated with baseball pitchers than basketball players.

"He's a total warrior and probably would've gone back in the game if we let him," Presti told reporters on Monday night.

The Thunder will use some mix of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander , Ajay Mitchell and Alex Caruso as primary ball-handlers with no Wallace.

SGA obviously has the ball a ton already, so it'll likely be a step up in usage for Mitchell and Caruso.

Both are quite capable, but this injury does thin out the Thunder's depth. They have to stay mostly healthy going forward to withstand these absences.

The Thunder will likely also give more minutes to Bennett Stirtz , the rookie point guard out of Iowa who has played sparingly in the early going. He'll be the mystery in the mix to see how he adjusts to the NBA level.

articles.title: When Will Jalen Williams Return? OKC Thunder GM Sam Presti Shares Major Update
articles.summary: When will Jalen Williams return? Thunder GM Sam Presti reveals his injury diagnosis, surgery plans and the latest on his recovery timeline. The post When Wil...
articles.body:
The Oklahoma City Thunder finally have an answer about Jalen Williams' frightening injury. The road ahead, however, remains uncertain.

Thunder general manager Sam Presti confirmed Monday that Williams suffered a fractured left fibula and a dislocated left ankle during Sunday's 108-101 victory over the Los Angeles Clippers.

The All-Star forward will require surgery, although Oklahoma City has not established a timetable for his return.

Presti delivered the update during a news conference Monday, less than 24 hours after Williams was taken off the court on a stretcher.

Despite the serious diagnosis, Presti said the 25-year-old remains remarkably upbeat.

Sam Presti Confirms Jalen Williams Injury Diagnosis

Presti said he spent time with Williams on Sunday night and again Monday morning.

"He's in great spirits and is extremely optimistic about the situation," Presti said during his news conference .

The Thunder executive then confirmed the extent of the damage.

"He's got a fractured fibula and dislocated ankle on the left side," Presti said.

Presti explained that the injury is more commonly associated with football players and requires an operation.

Williams has consulted with physicians, his representatives and family members while determining the next steps.

For now, the Thunder aren't prepared to estimate how much time he will miss.

"We'll have a timeline for everybody once we get through the surgery," Presti said.

He added that providing a timetable before the procedure would be inappropriate.

That leaves Oklahoma City facing a potentially lengthy absence without knowing when one of its most important players might return.

Jalen Williams Remains Optimistic Despite Surgery

Williams suffered the injury with 1:14 remaining in Sunday's victory at Paycom Center.

He drove toward the basket before absorbing contact from Clippers guard Kris Dunn .

Williams landed awkwardly, trapping his left leg beneath him.

Officials assessed Dunn a Flagrant 1 foul following a review.

Medical personnel immediately attended to Williams as his teammates watched in visible distress.

The arena fell silent before fans began chanting his nickname, "J-Dub."

Williams responded with two thumbs up as he was wheeled off the floor.

That display of composure carried into Monday.

Presti praised Williams' toughness and determination, describing his outlook following the injury as remarkable.

"He's as tough as they come," Presti said. "He's an elite competitor."

The Thunder plan to support Williams throughout his surgery and rehabilitation.

Thunder Face Uncertainty After Jalen Williams Injury

The diagnosis comes at a difficult time for Williams, who endured an injury-plagued 2025-26 season.

He missed 49 regular-season games while recovering from wrist surgery and dealing with hamstring problems.

Williams has been a cornerstone of Oklahoma City's success alongside Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Chet Holmgren .

His scoring, playmaking and defensive versatility make him difficult to replace.

Compounding the Thunder's injury concerns, Presti also confirmed that guard Cason Wallace suffered a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery. Like Williams, Wallace has no official return timetable until the team completes the surgical process.

Despite the double setback, Presti expressed confidence in both players' recoveries.

"We're extremely optimistic about the recovery for both the players," Presti said.

For now, Oklahoma City must adjust without two important members of its rotation.

Miami Dolphins running back Kaytron Allen made his team debut in Week 7 against the New York Jets, but his work was limited to special teams. The former Washington Commanders reserve was able to play six snaps on special teams.

articles.summary: Kentucky basketball is working hard on the 2027 recruiting class, and have made the final four for one of the top recruits.
articles.body:
Mark Pope and Kentucky basketball received some good recruiting news on Monday. First, they gained a prediction to land elite center Cheriff Millogo . Then, guard Adan Diggs revealed that he was down to four schools, and the Wildcats made the cut.

Per On3's Joe Tipton , Diggs is choosing between Kentucky , Arkansas, Arizona, and the USC Trojans , and is looking to make a decision soon. He is expected to announce a commitment in November.

Diggs is a 6'4", 180 lb combo guard out of Arizona who does a bit of everything. On the Nike EYBL circuit, he averaged 18 points, 6 rebounds, 3 assists, and 2 steals per game. He is currently rated five stars by 247Sports, and ranks as their No. 6 overall player in the class.

Kentucky already has four-star forward Ryan Hampton on board for next year, and landing both Millogo and Diggs would be a massive win for Pope, who has been criticized for his lack of top recruits. Diggs is definitely a top recruit, and would halt some of that criticism. We will continue to follow this story.

articles.title: Brewers and Rays have a lot in common, including Culver's sponsorships
articles.summary: In a series full of first times, the Brewers and Rays are the only two MLB teams with Culver's in-game promo.
articles.body:
In right-center field of Tropicana Field, the home of the Tampa Bay Rays , lies a Culver's sponsorship.

As the only two major league teams with Culver's as a partner, you could say the 'Culver's Classic' has officially arrived.

Both teams run Culver's-related promotions during home games.

In Tampa, the Rays do " Curds in the Third ," where fans get free cheese curds if the Rays score a run in the third inning.

Similarly for the Brewers, " Strikeouts for Custard ," gives fans free custard if a Brewers pitcher notches a strikeout in the third frame.

The fast-food burger chain has obvious ties to Wisconsin, where the restaurant was founded and still has the most locations. Culver's is also the official jersey patch sponsor of the Wisconsin Badgers and a longtime sponsor of Wisconsin athletics.

Still, Florida is one of the top three of states with the most Culver's locations, sitting at third in the nation with 138 locations.

As for Wisconsin, the state has 157 Culver's, accounting for about 14% of Culver's restaurants. Meanwhile, Florida sits behind Illinois, accounting for 12% of Culver's locations.

In October, Culver's announced a " Brew Crew Cheesecake ," that combines Culver's Vanilla Fresh Frozen Custard with cheesecake and blueberries, inspired by the Brewers' blue-and-gold colors.

The series is only the second World Series where two franchises who have never won an MLB championship are meeting in the Fall Classic. It is also the first time that two Culver's-sponsored teams are meeting in the World Series. Coincidence?

articles.title: Why police were called on 3-year-old who starred in Florida soccer tournament
articles.summary: Police in Winter Park, Fla. were called to settle a dispute between soccer tournament organizers and the family of a budding soccer prodigy. The reason for t...
articles.body:
Police in Winter Park, Fla. were called to settle a dispute between soccer tournament organizers and the family of a budding soccer prodigy. The reason for their alleged clash? The skills of the aforementioned soccer pupil.

Videos of the player took hold of social media on Monday. The videos, posted by the player's parents, showed the boy ghosting past opposition players before scoring. According to the parents, that was enough to run afoul of the tournament organizers, who reportedly responded by seeking out law enforcement.

Police called on 3-year-old for being 'too good' at soccer

A youth soccer tournament in Florida was disrupted after police were called to remove the family of a three-year old said to be playing too well against his peers. An organizer of the tournament told police that the player, a three-year-old boy named Nevada, was pushing other players, per ESPN .

Body camera footage of the police response released on Monday showed the child's parents alleging that Nevada, who is Black, was kicked out of the league too good.

One of Nevada's parents posted a clip of the interaction with police on social media on Monday, garnering millions of views.

The body camera footage showed the organizer, who works for nationwide youth sports organization i9 Sports, raving of Nevada's talents.

"The kid is good. He's great. Really good," the organizer said. "He's very advanced compared to the other ones, so he's scoring a lot of goals. But he's pushing the kids ... So, I try to tell him, don't push; we want to play without pushing, right?"

The organizer told police that Nevada's parents grew argumentative after their son was taken out of the game. The organizer then expressed frustration with the parents' reaction.

"I just want him out. Immediately," the organizer told police. "Just give me their names so I can give them their refund."

The video posted by the family didn't show Nevada making untoward physical contact. Officers didn't cite Nevada's family for its action, reportedly telling the organizer that they didn't have the power to do so.

An officer told another that he wanted to see Nevada play as interaction concluded.

"I kind of want to see him play," the officer said. "I bet he's good."

articles.title: Harry Kane vs Kylian Mbappé Net Worth 2026: How a $110 million wealth gap separates two of football’s biggest superstars
articles.summary: Harry Kane and Kylian Mbappé have built fortunes through elite football, lucrative club contracts and global sponsorship deals, but their estimated wealth
articles.body: Harry Kane and Kylian Mbappé have built fortunes through elite football, lucrative club contracts and global sponsorship deals, but their estimated wealth tells two different stories. Celebrity Net Worth values Mbappé at $250 million and Kane at $140 million in 2026, putting the French forward $110 million ahead. Both players earn substantial salaries at European giants, yet their careers have taken different financial paths. Mbappé's commercial appeal and Real Madrid agreement help explain the gap, while Kane's Bayern Munich contract has significantly increased his earning power.Harry Kane vs Kylian Mbappé net worth in 2026: Mbappé holds a $110 million leadThe figures published by Celebrity Net Worth put Mbappé's estimated fortune at $250 million, compared with Kane's $140 million.The difference is striking, but neither footballer's complete financial position is publicly available for independent verification. Net worth accounts for assets and liabilities, not just salary. The estimates offer a useful comparison, though they should not be treated as audited financial statements.Kane's rise has been built on years of consistent scoring in England and Germany. Mbappé, meanwhile, became a global star at an unusually young age, giving him more time to develop a commercial profile that extends well beyond his club career.How Kane's Bayern Munich move changed his financial positionFor much of his career, Kane's financial story was tied to Tottenham Hotspur. He came through the club's system, became its all-time leading scorer with 280 goals in 435 appearances and established himself as one of England's most reliable forwards. Yet his individual success did not bring the major team trophies he wanted in north London.That changed in August 2023, when Bayern Munich signed him from Tottenham for an initial €100 million, equivalent to £86.4 million, plus add-ons. Kane agreed to a four-year contract with the German champions.The move gave Kane a fresh sporting challenge and access to a substantial salary package. Capology estimates his gross fixed salary at €25 million for the 2026-27 season, excluding bonuses. Its figures are estimates rather than official salary disclosures, but they offer a useful guide to his earning power.His time in Munich has also delivered something that had eluded him at Tottenham: a major domestic trophy. Kane helped Bayern win the Bundesliga in 2024-25, giving his career a significant milestone after years of near misses. The achievement matters beyond the trophy cabinet. Continued success at a major European club helps sustain a player's profile, commercial appeal and bargaining position.Kane has also expanded his earning opportunities outside football. In August 2023, Skechers announced a lifetime global deal with the England captain as the footwear company launched its football boot range. The partnership made Kane a central figure in the brand's push into the sport.The financial terms were not publicly disclosed, so it would be misleading to assign a precise value to the deal. Still, a long-term partnership of this kind gives Kane another commercial platform beyond his club wages.His estimated $140 million fortune reflects that broader earning history, although the exact contribution from salary, endorsements, investments and other assets remains private.Why Mbappé's fortune is estimated to be $250 millionMbappé's financial rise began early. He emerged as a teenager at Monaco, helped the club win Ligue 1 in 2016-17 and moved to Paris Saint-Germain in 2017. His performances for PSG and France soon turned him into one of the most recognisable figures in world football.Winning the 2018 World Cup with France at 19 gave him a global platform that few players reach so young. His performances at the 2022 World Cup, where he won the Golden Boot, further strengthened his reputation. That visibility has helped make him attractive to major international brands as well as wealthy football clubs.His move to Real Madrid in 2024 marked another important step. The Spanish club confirmed a five-season agreement after his PSG contract expired.The financial structure reported at the time was particularly significant. BBC Sport reported an annual salary of €15 million, or £12.8 million, alongside a €150 million signing-on bonus paid over five years. Mbappé was also set to retain a share of his image rights.A signing bonus of that scale can have a major effect on a player's overall compensation, even when the club does not pay a transfer fee to acquire him. Real Madrid benefited from signing Mbappé as a free agent, while the forward secured a valuable long-term agreement.His commercial reach adds another layer. Mbappé has worked with brands including Nike, Hublot, Dior, Oakley and EA Sports. He has also moved into football ownership through investment company Coalition Capital, which acquired a majority stake in French club Caen in 2024.These interests distinguish his financial profile from one built mainly around playing wages. However, the value of his private investments and the money he retains after taxes, fees and expenses are not fully public. The $250 million figure remains an estimate, not a confirmed balance sheet.Who earns more each year, Kane or Mbappé?The net worth comparison becomes more interesting when annual income enters the picture. A player's estimated fortune measures accumulated wealth, while annual earnings show how much money he generates over a particular period. The two figures are related, but they are not interchangeable.Forbes' 2025 ranking of the world's highest-paid footballers estimated Mbappé's annual earnings at $95 million for the period covered by its list. That included $70 million from football and $25 million from commercial activities.Kane also remains among football's highest earners. Forbes' 2026 profile listed his estimated annual earnings at $42 million, placing him ninth on its ranking.These figures come from different annual assessments, so they should not be treated as a direct comparison of earnings over an identical period. They nevertheless show the scale of income available to both players.Mbappé's reported Real Madrid signing bonus, his salary and his commercial partnerships give him several routes to generate substantial revenue. Kane's Bayern wages and Skechers partnership provide a strong financial foundation, but the available estimates suggest a smaller overall income stream.There is another important distinction. A club's transfer fee is not money paid directly into a player's personal account. Tottenham's reported €100 million initial fee for Kane, for example, went to the club. Similarly, Mbappé's arrival at Real Madrid on a free transfer did not mean he received a transfer fee himself.His reported signing bonus was a separate part of his employment agreement. Keeping those categories apart is essential when comparing football finances.Can Kane close the $110 million gap with Mbappé?Kane's estimated $140 million net worth puts him among the wealthiest players of his generation, but Mbappé's reported $250 million fortune leaves him with a sizeable lead. The gap is not necessarily fixed. Both players remain active, and their future earnings will depend on contracts, commercial agreements, investments and how long they continue playing at the highest level.Kane's position could improve if he extends his Bayern contract or secures further commercial opportunities. BBC Sport reported in January 2026 that Bayern were discussing a possible extension with the striker. His existing agreement was due to expire in 2027, making his next contract an important consideration for his future earnings.Mbappé, meanwhile, has a longer-term agreement with Real Madrid that runs through 2029. His investment interests could also contribute to his wealth, although their current values and returns are not fully disclosed.There is no reliable way to predict exactly how the gap will change. Taxes, personal spending, investment performance and private liabilities all affect net worth, and the public does not have access to a complete account of either player's finances.What the available information does establish is that Mbappé has a higher published net worth estimate and a strong record of commercial earning power. Kane's wealth, meanwhile, reflects a long career at the top level and a major financial step forward after leaving Tottenham.For readers comparing the two in 2026, the $110 million difference is a useful headline figure, not a definitive measure of their private assets. The more revealing story is how two elite forwards have turned their football careers into valuable financial portfolios through different routes.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: WADA allows Ozempic, Mounjaro use under 2027 anti-doping rules
articles.summary: New Delhi: Athletes using popular weight-loss drugs Ozempic and Mounjaro can continue taking them under anti-doping rules, with the World Anti-Doping
articles.body: New Delhi: Athletes using popular weight-loss drugs Ozempic and Mounjaro can continue taking them under anti-doping rules, with the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) retaining the substances on its monitoring programme rather than adding them to the updated prohibited list. The 2027 list comes into effect on Jan 1 and will apply globally to signatories of the World Anti-Doping Code, including Indian athletes governed by the National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA).Ozempic, Mounjaro and similar drugs belong to the GLP-1 receptor agonist class, widely used for weight management and diabetes treatment. WADA senior director of science and medicine Olivier Rabin cautioned athletes against using the drugs without professional supervision, warning that their substantial physiological effects could carry serious risks.“The prohibited list expert advisory group and the ExCo considered the status of GLP-1 receptor agonists carefully,” Rabin said, adding that existing evidence was insufficient to justify a ban. WADA has commissioned further research to establish their effects.According to WADA, for a substance to be prohibited, it must meet at least two of three criteria: potential performance enhancement, health risks to athletes or violation of the spirit of sport.The 2027 list also explicitly permits vaginal administration of glucocorticoids, while other routes remain subject to restrictions. Cannabidiol (CBD) continues to be permitted, although primary psychoactive compounds found in cannabis (marijuana, hashish, cocaine) remain prohibited in competition.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Valkyries push Dream to the brink, move one win away from WNBA title
articles.summary: Kiah Stokes had 13 points, eight rebounds and three blocks as the Golden State Valkyries beat the Atlanta Dream 64-55 in Game 5 to take 3-2 lead in the WNBA Finals.
articles.body: Kiah Stokes had 13 points, eight rebounds and three blocked shots as the Golden State Valkyries moved within one win of a championship in their second season, beating the Atlanta Dream 64-55 in Game 5 of the WNBA Finals on Monday night. Angel Reese finished with seven points, 15 rebounds and five assists — a big difference from her two standout performances in the first two games of the series at Chase Center. Reese shook her head when whistled for the second of her three offensive fouls with 7:43 to play. Fans screamed and clapped thunder sticks following the final buzzer as Stokes spoke from the floor to chants of “MVP!” “We appreciate you,” a smiling Stokes said. “We got one more.” On a night leading scorer Gabby Williams struggled to find her shooting touch, Golden State found that “strength in numbers” mantra coach Natalie Nakase has praised all season long and everybody made an impact. Veronica Burton had 13 points and eight rebounds. On Saturday, Nakase had changed up her lineup for a 67-62 Game 4 win by inserting Tiffany Hayes and Kaila Charles into the starting five. She stayed with those two Monday night, and it worked again. Hayes, who played 10 seasons for Atlanta and came out of retirement two years ago, had 12 points — and Nakase has said she wants to win it all for the veteran guard. Williams began 2 for 11 and missed all four of her three 3-point tries, but she converted a three-point play with 9:08 remaining put the Valkyries ahead 49-42 and finished with nine points on 3-for-14 shooting and six rebounds. Atlanta will now try to stave off elimination at home Thursday in Game 6 and force a deciding Game 7 back here at Chase Center on Saturday. The Dream hurt themselves with 17 turnovers that led to 21 points for Golden State. Stokes hit a key 3-pointer with 2:46 to go in the third quarter and another with 7:21 left in the game, which ignited chants of “Ki-ah! Ki-ah!” from the crazed, rally-towel waving “Ballhalla” home crowd at Chase Center. Stokes has recorded three or more blocks in six straight games, tying her with Lisa Leslie in 2003 for the longest such streak in a single WNBA postseason. The Valkyries used a dominant second half after they led 25-22 at the break, the lowest scoring first half combined score in WNBA Finals history. Rhyne Howard’s three-point play with 4:59 left in the third pulled Atlanta within 34-31, but after that it was Stokes, Burton and the Valkyries coming up with all the crucial plays on both ends. Golden State owner Joe Lacob promised a championship within five years in a bold declaration when the expansion franchise was granted to the Bay Area three years ago, yet this season has exceeded even what he could have envisioned. Neither team could find a flow from 3-point range in the first half as the teams combined to shoot 5 for 29 from deep — 3 of 16 by Golden State and 2 for 13 by Atlanta. Earlier Monday, the league announced Game 6 would be played at 17,000-seat State Farm Arena in Atlanta starting at 12:30 p.m. EDT on Thursday — a time when many fans on both coasts will be working. “I’d like to see it be a national holiday for all WNBA championship games so whatever somebody can do,” Dream coach Karl Smesko said. “I hope everybody gets to see it somehow and I know that for some people it’s not realistic, they have jobs and won’t be able to make it. So I’m disappointed for that but I’m really hopeful that as many people can see the game as possible.”

articles.title: ‘I’ve missed this feeling more than I can explain’: PV Sindhu after French Open final
articles.summary: Hyderabad: On Sunday, PV Sindhu walked off the court in Paris with a silver medal and a smile.
articles.body: Hyderabad: On Sunday, PV Sindhu walked off the court in Paris with a silver medal and a smile. She had lost the French Open final to South Korea’s An Se-young 16-21, 21-11, 21-12 in 61 minutes, but the result told only part of the story.For Sindhu, the journey to the final marked a welcome return to form after years of injuries, disappointments and difficult defeats.“Of course, I wanted the gold. But there’s a part of me that’s just really happy to feel all those long days, difficult losses and endless hours of work finally beginning to mean something.“I’ve missed this feeling more than I can explain,” read Sindhu’s Insta post after the final.Her recent triumph at the Japan Open, a prestigious BWF Super 750 tournament in July, had signalled a revival. The French Open campaign offered further evidence of her return to form.Working under coach Irwansyah, Sindhu has focused on improving her front-court play, exercising greater patience and maintaining control during rallies. Her semifinal victory over Japan’s Hina Akechi (21-10, 20-22, 21-16) in 73 minutes demonstrated her resilience and determination.Against An, Sindhu made an encouraging start, taking the opening game after leading 11-9 at the interval. However, the world No. 1 raised her intensity in the second game and secured her fourth French Open title.The defeat extended Sindhu’s losing streak against An, whose rise to the top has been built on exceptional speed, consistency and court coverage. Sindhu was keen to acknowledge her rival’s achievements rather than dwell on the disappointment.“@a_sy_2225, keep shining. articles.title: Pat McAfee invokes Charlie Kirk killing as Utah post sparks 'uncomfortable' GameDay visit
articles.summary: Pat McAfee ripped the University of Utah over an Instagram video posted before "College GameDay," pointing to the Charlie Kirk shooting 40 miles away.
articles.body: ESPN star Pat McAfee appeared to reference the killing of Charlie Kirk as he ripped the University of Utah over a social media post he says made him feel "very, very uncomfortable" before Saturday’s "College GameDay" broadcast. McAfee said he saw a video on the university’s Instagram account shortly before going on air in Salt Lake City. The post asked students to do impressions of him, he said, and included comments calling him "corny" and "creepy." The video has since been removed from the university’s social media accounts. PAT MCAFEE HAS OFFICIALLY SURPASSED STEPHEN A SMITH AS THE FACE OF ESPN The former NFL punter said he would not have minded if students had shared the remarks themselves, but he took issue with the university posting them before he walked in front of thousands of fans. "The university puts that out, like as I’m about to go out and do an infomercial for the place, and then I’m walking in front of thousands of these people," McAfee said Monday on "The Pat McAfee Show." "This is how the university feels about it. It’s an uncomfortable feeling." McAfee said the post "set me off a little bit" and made him feel "a little weird." He then appeared to reference the September 2025 shooting of Kirk, the conservative activist who was killed during an event at Utah Valley University in Orem, about 40 miles south of Salt Lake City. 30% OF COLLEGE STUDENTS SAY VIOLENCE ACCEPTABLE WAY TO STOP SPEAKERS ON CAMPUSES, SURVEY FINDS "Has anything like really scary happened at like a college gathering in the state of Utah recently?" McAfee asked. "Like, do we think we should be amplifying reasons for why people hate my guts as a university?" Later in the segment, McAfee again pointed to "what happened 40 miles south of Salt Lake City a little over a year ago," saying the university’s post added to the hostility he faces just before he went on air to promote the school. CHARLIE KIRK'S FAMILY ALLEGES UVU KNEW OF ROOFTOP SECURITY RISK BEFORE HIS ASSASSINATION: LEGAL FILING "I was very, very uncomfortable," he said. "I think it made me not have the greatest morning." The University of Utah apologized in a statement posted to its official Instagram account, saying its goal was to create "lighthearted engagement" about McAfee’s return to campus, but it "missed the mark." "University staff are responsible for reviewing and posting content on official social media accounts and we take full accountability for that decision," the school said. The university said officials had reached out to McAfee to express their appreciation and regret. "We sincerely apologize for creating any perception that Pat was unsafe or unwelcome on our campus. Nothing could be further from the truth," the statement said. The school added that McAfee and the entire "College GameDay" crew are always welcome at the university. It said ESPN’s pregame show has visited its campus seven times and that it has enjoyed a positive relationship with the crew. It’s not like a blog. It’s the actual place that we’re at," he said. He also took issue with a student participating in his weekly "Kicking Is Easy" contest, which gives a contestant a chance to kick a field goal for $1 million. McAfee said the student questioned why the prize was "only $1 million" after the potential prize reached $3 million for the previous week’s Notre Dame-BYU game. "It’s my money! Only $1 million. It’s like, all right, I hate this place. I hate this place," he said. McAfee said he hopes he never has to return to the university and joked that he might have COVID if "College GameDay" goes back. Despite his frustrations, he praised Utah’s football team and called its student section "incredible." He also thanked the fans who attended Saturday’s broadcast. articles.title: European Curling Championships 2026: Scotland rinks eye medals
articles.summary: Grant Hardie and Fay Henderson lead their respective Scottish rinks to the European Championships with medals in mind.
articles.body:
A glance at the make-up of the Scotland teams going to this week's European Curling Championship tells a story.

This time last year, the Scottish women took silver and the men bronze. Yet only three of the 10 curlers who comprised those rinks will be involved in Ostrava over the next six days.

So it says something about the strength of curling in Scotland that all of those who travelled to the Czech city on Monday did so with medals in mind.

Fay Henderson and Grant Hardie were among those who competed in Finland a year ago. The former as the alternate - or non-playing member - of the women's team and Hardie as deputy to Bruce Mouat in the men's quartet.

Now, both have ascended to the skip role and lead new teams, both of which earned their place at the event by winning the Scottish Championships earlier this year in the immediate aftermath of the Winter Olympics.

Watch selected games live on the BBC iPlayer and the BBC Sport website and app

Hardie ended that event on the podium in tears after a second consecutive silver medal. Three months later, he announced he would leave Team Mouat after nine glorious years and become skip of what was Team (Ross) Whyte.

Already ranked in the world's top five, they go into these Euros with one aim in mind. "I think it's quite clear for us we want to go there and win it," Hardie told BBC Sport Scotland. "We'll be going in as a top-ranked team but it's a really strong field."

While no longer a qualifier for the Worlds, the chance to lay down a marker at the beginning of the Olympics cycle is one Hardie and his team are eager to take.

And the feeling is similar for Henderson and her rink. While she stops short of saying gold is the target, a podium place is in her sights.

"I've never actually played a game at the Europeans before but have two medals [silver and bronze], which is a bit of a strange feeling," Henderson says. "But I'd love to complete the set.

"But, really, we want to show the top teams that we're definitely a force to be reckoned with."

Jesse Love leads the standings after a wild Talladega finish. Justin Allgaier sits just 19 points behind, while Corey Day trails by 29. Sheldon Creed is still within 50 points.

With Martinsville next and the season finale approaching, the championship is absolutely up for grabs.

Sammy Smith Just Stole the Show at Talladega

Kvapil had been the dominant driver for much of the afternoon. Smith needed only one lap in front to claim the victory.

One driver leaves disappointed. Another walks away with a moment he will remember for the rest of his career.

articles.title: Cavs’ Donovan Mitchell believes Meleek Thomas is ‘gonna be special’
articles.summary: Meleek Thomas had to wait to make his debut with the Cleveland Cavaliers. When he was finally given the chance to play on Monday, he made the most of it. Th...
articles.body:
Meleek Thomas had to wait to make his debut with the Cleveland Cavaliers . When he was finally given the chance to play on Monday, he made the most of it.

The Cavaliers dealt the Minnesota Timberwolves their first loss of the season, escaping with a two-point win, 127-125, in overtime at Rocket Arena.

Thomas was an unlikely hero, finishing with 16 points, two rebounds, and one steal in 19 minutes off the bench. He shot 6-of-10 from the field, including 4-of-5 from three-point range.

Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial)

Donovan Mitchell made sure to give credit to the 20-year-old guard.

"Everybody in here needs to give Meleek Thomas a round of applause. For a rookie debut, that kid's gonna be special," said Mitchell in the postgame interview.

"He was the spark when we didn't have anything in the first half. He was the key, and we followed suit. It's not many times you follow a rookie. So credit to him."

Thomas, who lit up the Summer League , was glued to the bench in their first two games, as coach Kenny Atkinson opted for Craig Porter Jr. and Tyrese Protector in the second unit. With his impressive showing, Thomas may have earned a permanent spot in the rotation.

The former Arkansas standout fell to the second round in June. The Sacramento Kings drafted with him the No. 34 pick before trading him to the Cavaliers in exchange for Alex Karaban, whom the Wine and Gold selected with the No. 29 pick.

With Mitchell's stamp of approval, Williams will only get more confident.

The Cavaliers will visit the Washington Wizards on Wednesday.

articles.title: KIMI ANTONELLI IS ONE RACE FROM F1 HISTORY! The Mexican Grand Prix Could Crown a New World Champion
articles.summary: Formula 1 could be on the verge of witnessing history. Kimi Antonelli won the United States Grand Prix in Austin on Oct. 25, extending his championship lead...
articles.body:
Formula 1 could be on the verge of witnessing history.

Kimi Antonelli won the United States Grand Prix in Austin on Oct. 25, extending his championship lead and putting himself within touching distance of his first world title.

Now, the spotlight shifts to Mexico City. The question is no longer whether the Mercedes driver has championship potential. It is whether anyone can stop him from becoming the youngest Formula 1 world champion in history.

Antonelli leads the standings with 365 points, 123 ahead of teammate George Russell and 124 clear of Lewis Hamilton.

With only five rounds remaining after Austin, the mathematics are becoming increasingly difficult for his rivals.

The 20-year-old can clinch the championship at the Mexican Grand Prix on Nov. 1 by finishing ninth or better. He could also seal the title if neither Russell nor Hamilton wins the race.

That is an extraordinary position for a driver still in only his second Formula 1 season.

Antonelli has already won nine Grands Prix this year. His latest victory in Austin came after he started from pole position and finished more than 13 seconds ahead of Charles Leclerc.

Russell and Hamilton remain the only drivers mathematically capable of catching Antonelli.

That is a remarkable development in a season that once featured a much wider championship conversation. Max Verstappen, Charles Leclerc and other contenders have been eliminated from title contention.

Antonelli's advantage is substantial, but the championship is not officially over yet. A difficult weekend in Mexico could delay the celebrations.

Mercedes also has an opportunity to secure the constructors' championship, adding another potential milestone to an already enormous weekend.

Hamilton became a global superstar by winning seven world championships. Verstappen built a dominant run of his own. Now, Antonelli is on the verge of announcing himself as the sport's next defining champion.

Winning a title at 20 would be a historic achievement. Doing it in just his second season would make the accomplishment even more remarkable.

The Mexican Grand Prix could become a coronation — or the opening of one final chapter of suspense.

F1 fans, is Kimi Antonelli already the face of the sport's future? Or does he need to win multiple championships before earning that label?
